description: This file defines a report for 'Prospects Engaged But Not Converted' in the ERPNext CRM module. It includes functions to set default filters, generate report columns, fetch lead data with communication history, and apply lead filters based on age and status.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: set_defaut_value_for_filters
methods.description: Sets default values for 'no_of_interaction' and 'lead_age' filters if not provided.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the structure and labels of the report columns.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches lead details and communication history based on filters.

methods.name: get_lead_filters
methods.description: Constructs filters for leads based on status, creation date, and optional lead ID.

methods.name: get_creation_date_based_on_lead_age
methods.description: Calculates the lead creation date threshold based on lead age filter.
